verses.gurmukhi: ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਅਉ ਪਤੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chakiee chakor mirag meen bhira(n)g aau pata(n)g preet ik a(n)gee bahu ra(n)gee dhukhadhaiee hai ||

en.bdb: The love of a Ruddy Sheldrake with Sun, Allictoris gracea with Moon, deer with melody of Ghandey Herhey, fish with water, a black bee with lotus flower and of a moth with light is one-sided. Such one-sided love is often painful in many ways.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਚਲੀ ਜਗ ਆਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ek ek Tek sai Tarat na marat sabai aadh a(n)t kee su chaal chalee jag aaiee hai ||

en.bdb: All these lovers do not abstain from their faith of one-sided love and in the process give away their lives. This tradition of worldly love is going on since the beginning of ages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅੇਸੋ ਲੋਗ ਪਰਲੋਗ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap aeso log paralog sukhadhaik sahaiee hai ||

en.bdb: But the importance of two-sided love of a Sikh of the Guru and his True Guru is such that can prove helpful and peaceful in this world and the world beyond.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat sun dhuramat na miTat jaa kee eh mil cha(n)dhan jiau bikh na miTaiee hai ||316||

en.bdb: With such comforting love of the Guru available close at hand, if one does not listen to the teachings of the Guru and who does not dispel one's base wisdom, then such a person is no better than a snake who does not shed his venom even after embracing Sandalwood tree. (316)
